results.name: The full library separates unread filing work from actual review exceptions
An active Refresh reports real progress, merges duplicate requests and permits offline browsing after reload
Cancel stops the real import cooperatively without continuing into library generation or losing evidence
A subsequent unchanged Refresh finishes after reload and reuses cached readable PDFs
Reading one unsupported synthetic PDF creates one genuine review exception
Reason groups support atomic selected decisions, stale protection and durable batch Undo

scope: Real local host, worker, archive loop and browser. A disposable copied Set-QaProgress checkpoint supplies a deterministic barrier; the real cooperative cancellation and production persistence run unchanged.
